notes.title: 🅿️ Parking Tycoon 2 - From Empty Lots to a Thriving Parking Empire!
notes.content:
[p]Parking Tycoon 2 is a first-person business simulator where you turn empty land into a thriving parking empire.
[/p][p]Build, manage, and expand - you’re in full control. Design layouts, install ticket machines, add lighting, fences, security, and amenities to attract more customers and grow your income.
[/p][p]This brand-new sequel brings enhanced visuals, smarter systems, and fresh mechanics that make every decision more meaningful - from pricing strategy to customer satisfaction. You’ll face unexpected challenges and make key choices that shape your business story.
[/p][p]New to the series? No problem - [b]Parking Tycoon 2[/b] is a perfect starting point.

Curious about the original? Check it out here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475420/Parking_Tycoon_Business_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Ready to build your empire and take the industry by storm?[/p]
